fusions.name: Linked Quills
fusions.desc: Flings a quill into the first enemy it meets for 4 damage. It then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 50% of that.

fusions.name: Wheeling Tether
fusions.desc: Swings a tether in a full circle, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles with a 50% chance of [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds. Your afflictions on each spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Swung Lure
fusions.desc: Swings a lure on a line, pulling up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Slipped Jesses
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 6. When it reaches 6, they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (27% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
